- counter | RQ1 | Abstract | opposing result | Allowing AI tools increased completion time by 19%. | 允许使用 AI 工具后，完成时间反而增加了 19%。
- evidence | RQ3 | Abstract | strong | Developers expected a 24% speed-up and, after the slowdown, still believed AI had sped them up by 20%. | 开发者预期提速 24%，实际变慢后仍认为 AI 让他们快了 20%。
